title: XscriptX
features:
⚡ XscriptX Hub: Dominate Arsenal Without Breaking a Sweat.

Tired of generic scripts that lag your game, aimbots that lock onto walls, or dead bodies making your camera jitter?

Meet XscriptX Hub, a next-gen, custom-coded script. Built for absolute performance and stealth, it crushes the competition on Arsenal and other Roblox FPS games with unique bypasses and unmatched smoothness.

🎯 Combat & Aimbot: Zero Delay, Zero Mercy

Forget about aimbots that drag or feel one frame behind.

Insta-Lock Aimbot: Absolute and instantaneous lock tied directly to the game's camera render engine. When you click, it hits.

Smart Target Engine: The aimbot intelligently ignores dead players, ragdolls, and bodies falling under the map. No more crosshairs randomly snapping to the floor!

Wall Check (LOS): Smart raycasting. The script knows if an enemy is behind a wall and ignores them for a 100% Legit look (can be toggled off for Rage mode).

Hitbox Expander (Silent Aim): Enlarge the enemy team's hitboxes while keeping them completely invisible. Shoot way off-target, land guaranteed headshots.

Gun Mods: No Recoil, No Spread, Custom Fire Rate, and Instant Reload. Break the limits of your weapons.

👁️ Visuals & ESP: See Everything, Show Nothing

Uses native Drawing API methods for a clean, Streamproof overlay (completely invisible if you record with OBS).

Ultra-Complete ESP: 2D/3D Boxes, Skeletons, Dynamic Health Bars, Names, Equipped Weapons, and Tracers.

Interactive Radar: A fully customizable mini-radar (zoom, colors, size) so you always know who's flanking you.

Deep Customization: Change fonts, tweak colors, and apply custom Neon, Forcefield, or Rainbow effects to your guns.

🚀 Movement & Map Control

Become untouchable by manipulating physics on the fly.

Safe Auto-TP: Automatically teleport behind enemies to chain kills, featuring a built-in failsafe that prevents you from teleporting into the void.

Anti-Fling: Is a spinner exploiter trying to fling you off the map? The script absorbs the impact and forces your velocity to 0, keeping you safely grounded.

Fly, Noclip & Bhop: Move at lightning speed and walk straight through walls.

⚙️ Premium UI & Auto-Load

Hand-Coded UI: No generic, overused UI libraries here. A sleek, dark-themed interface with smooth tween animations and a built-in RGB/HSV Color Picker.

Auto-Load System: Save your configs (Legit, Rage, Sniper...). Turn on Auto-Load, and your cheats will automatically set themselves up upon injection. Never waste time redoing your settings every match!

Panic Button: A moderator just joined the server? Hit your secret keybind to instantly disable all cheats, wipe the ESP, and restore normal game physics.

💬 Ready to ruin your opponents' night?
Inject XscriptX, toggle Auto-Load, and enjoy the show.
